Defaults precisely #05070f background, #00e5ff main branch, #d6ff00 alternate branch, #ff2bd6 synapse, #fff36a pulse, #ffd400 accent. Setup: lightweight arrays of 3–6 seed neurons random near center, with 3–5 initial divergent dendrite/axon growth frontiers each. Clamp pulse number, render moving yellow electric sparks with shadowBlur and tiny trails. If pulse connections scarce, ensure growth across central seeds frequently results in synapses by initial seeds near center and direction variation; do not fabricate connections beyond threshold. Clear canvas button empties network without auto regenerating, showing only the dark base; regenerate resets all and resumes. Pause freezes growth and pulse simulation (render still possible). Implement separate short named functions for setup/reset, GUI, growth, synapse detection, pulse update, rendering. No canvas-generated noise texture/images; use direct draws. Beautiful polished high-contrast slightly gritty aesthetic, performant and self contained aside from permitted dat.gui."}
